text: Owner answers, 2026-09-27: bandwidth stays $0.06/GB; margin raised to 30% (single setting); Starter limits as proposed; a Starter checkout trials Starter (the chosen plan); Deployer role = deploy + view only (no env, domains, resources, security, members or billing changes); view-only members are free (not seats); private beta is open sign-up; no extra beta perks; support by email at hello@dply.io; changelog security entry uses generic wording ("hardened tenant isolation and build sandboxing"); paused accounts' data is deleted after 30 days (purge on, with warning emails); public origin is https://edge.dply.io (app, docs, API, CLI default); docs name infrastructure vendors (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean).
